codeReview.summary: The fix correctly updates both picking_validation.rs (7 errors resolved) and outline_validation.rs (85 errors resolved) to use the new robustness milestone APIs. All four categories of API changes are addressed: GpuAllocator wrapper methods, Result-returning command buffer operations, Result-returning memory flush/invalidate operations, and proper VulkanContext::init_headless() Result unwrapping. The outline_validation context is correctly wrapped in Rc for PipelineBuilder compatibility. Error handling is consistent and appropriate — ? operator in functions returning Result, and match-based early returns in main(). Both examples compile cleanly and all verification commands passed.

sharedStateObservations.observation: particle_validation.rs and particle_validation_helpers.rs are also broken by the same robustness milestone API changes (38 compile errors: GpuAllocator.borrow_mut(), begin_single_time_commands() returning Result, init_headless() returning Result, create_image() returning Result). These examples were not included in the fix feature scope but are now uncompilable. The AGENTS.md mission file lists 'GPU examples for validation' including particle_validation specifically.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: cargo check -p katla_gfx --example particle_validation --features validation produces 38 errors. Affected patterns: allocator.borrow_mut() at particle_validation.rs:220,262 and particle_validation_helpers.rs:184; context.begin_single_time_commands() used without Result handling at particle_validation.rs:288,791,967; VulkanContext::init_headless() wrapped in Rc without Result unwrap at particle_validation.rs:687-688.

sharedStateObservations.observation: services.yaml does not include commands for the GPU validation examples that the AGENTS.md mission file references. The mission lists cargo run -p katla_gfx --example picking_validation and outline_validation, but services.yaml only has headless_validation (cargo run -- -s). Adding example-specific validation commands would improve discoverability.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: AGENTS.md lists 'cargo run -p katla_gfx --example picking_validation' and 'cargo run -p katla_gfx --example outline_validation' but services.yaml commands section has no matching entries.
